delete-layer-chain-refusal.message: Bitwig has no typed deletion of one layer chain. Nothing was written. Remove the layer chain with computer control in Bitwig: confirm the focus and the target, delete it, then read_devices again.

why: a deleted track cannot be brought back. A newly created track gets a new id, so it is a different track and nothing recorded about the old one can be replayed onto it.
